title: Titanium Valve Strainer Basket

Its strength-to-weight ratio is 45% better than steel, making it the most widely used titanium alloy in aerospace, medical, and industrial applications.
commonFailures: Crevice corrosion at seat interface in stagnant chemical service

faq.q: What is a titanium valve strainer basket?
faq.a: A titanium valve strainer basket is a precision-machined valve component component used in perforated valve strainer basket. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What pressure rating for titanium valve strainer basket?
faq.a: Pressure rating depends on grade, wall thickness, and temperature. Grade 2 CP-Ti pipe fittings are typically rated to Class 150 (285 psi) or Class 300 (740 psi) per ASME B16.5/B16.9. Higher ratings available with Grade 5.

faq.q: How is titanium valve strainer basket manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Valve Strainer Basket is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium valve strainer basket?
faq.a: The most common issue is crevice corrosion at seat interface in stagnant chemical service. Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
